thread:
Mina: quick visual pass on the routing policies editor — noticed a few tiny but impactful UX nits :eyes:
Mina: 1) priority column drag handle overlaps the rule preview tooltip when you hover, makes the tooltip hard to read
Mina: 2) validation copy on the 'sequence conflict' modal feels scary — can we soften and be actionable (e.g., 'These rules may never run; try reordering or adding scope')
Devin: thanks — can you repro steps? I couldn't get the tooltip to clip earlier
Mina: repro: create 3 rules, narrow window width to ~1200px, hover the middle rule's preview. handle sits on top of the tooltip and the tooltip caret points to wrong element
Devin: got it. seems z-index + transform stacking context. quick CSS fix likely. I can push a patch to staging for the editor iframe
Sara PM: also think copy tweak: replace 'sequence conflict' header with 'Conflicting rule order' and add an inline suggestion line: 'Try moving rule X before rule Y to allow match' — less scary, more useful
Jordan: agree on copy. on preview simulation: when preview is active and you reorder rules the live preview disappears for a second; could we persist the preview and show a small 'recomputing...' badge instead of hiding? keeps mental model stable
Ava (a11y): a11y notes: drag handles need aria-labels like 'Drag to reorder rule {index}' and should be keyboard operable with space/enter to pick up, arrow keys to nudge. Also the tooltip should not be the only source of the rule example — include an inline, always-visible condensed example for screen readers
Devin: solid. I'll add aria-labels and keyboard handlers. For the tooltip overlap I'll try increasing z-index and removing transform from wrapper to avoid creating new stacking context. snippet to test:```
.rule-row { transform: none; z-index: 2; }
.preview-tooltip { z-index: 10; }
```
Devin: will also change the preview hide behavior to show a translucent overlay with 'recomputing preview' so it doesn't jump
Mina: copy suggestion for the modal body: 'Some rules are currently ordered in a way that prevents others from matching. Rearranging the rules or broadening scopes can resolve this.' and add a 'Show example' link that expands a concrete sample input
Sara PM: love that — include a small inline CTA 'Fix order' that opens the reorder helper and highlights the two rules in question
ui-bot: screenshot upload: https://redwood.screenshots/ci/1815004321/preview_overlap.png :camera_flash:
Jordan: QA checklist: reproduce at 1200px+ and 1024px, test keyboard reorder, test preview persistence, run accessibility audit for tooltip focus order
Devin: assigning to me. I'll drop a staging build by EOD and paste link
Mina: awesome. thanks! leaving the microcopy and a11y follow-ups to Sara and Ava respectively :thumbsup:
Sara PM: I'll draft the modal copy and CTA labels, share in this thread
Ava (a11y): I'll add the aria examples and a short keyboard interaction doc snippet that we can link from the editor's help panel :a11y:
Mina: merging notes into the design doc after the staging build review.
